data.description:
recordings/ holds Brandon's own voice recordings for local benchmarks (ramble.wav, structured.wav and the reference text). It's gitignored, so it won't come along with the repo. Copy it by hand to the same path on the new Mac mini, e.g. over the local network or from a backup. Never upload it anywhere public.

Without it, the real-voice benches (docs/model-bench.md "Real voice" and later sections) can't be re-run on the new machine. The public testdata/ clips still work.
data.title: Copy recordings/ to the new Mac mini by hand (gitignored, private)
